context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on a historic trial.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; legal vocabulary (裁判/訴訟/犯罪/弁護士/措置) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この裁判は、歴史に残ったんですね。
lines.en: This trial went down in history.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、長い訴訟の末の判決でした。
lines.en: Yes, a ruling after a long lawsuit.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 弁護士は、どう闘ったんですか?
lines.en: How did the lawyer fight it?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 弁護士は、証拠を一つずつ示しました。
lines.en: The lawyer presented evidence one by one.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 犯罪の証明は、難しかったんでしょうね。
lines.en: Proving the crime must have been hard.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その後、再発防止の措置が取られました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この訴訟が、法律を変えたんですね。
lines.en: So this lawsuit changed the law.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一つの裁判が、社会を動かしたんですよ。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity closing throughout
